scenarios.title: Sign in and chat
scenarios.goal: Hold a normal conversation and use the core chat controls
scenarios.before: Work only with synthetic data. Allie describes itself as able to make mistakes, so judge the answer against what you can verify.

steps.text: Open Allie and sign in with your Microsoft 365 account. Open New Chat.
steps.expect: You land in an empty chat that greets you with a prompt such as "What are you making progress on today?".

steps.text: Ask: "Give me three tips for {{td.topic}}. End your answer with the code word {{td.canary}}."
steps.expect: A relevant, readable answer streams in and it ends with your code word.

steps.text: Open the model selector, choose a different model and ask the same question again.
steps.expect: The answer is produced by the newly selected model and the selection is shown.

steps.text: Use Copy and then Retry on a reply, then press Ctrl+K and search for a word from your chat.
steps.expect: Copy places the text on the clipboard, Retry makes a fresh answer and search finds your chat.

steps.text: Bookmark the chat and rename or delete a second, throwaway chat.
steps.expect: The bookmarked chat appears under Bookmarked and the deleted chat disappears from the list.

steps.text: Open Allie on a phone-sized window (or your phone) and send one message.
steps.expect: The layout stays usable: sidebar collapses, the message box and Send are reachable.

scenarios.title: Rich output and downloads
scenarios.goal: Check that generated artifacts render and download correctly

steps.text: Ask for a Markdown table comparing three project risks for {{td.topic}}, with columns Risk, Likelihood and Mitigation.
steps.expect: A correctly formatted table is displayed, not raw Markdown text.

steps.text: Ask for a Mermaid flowchart of a simple approval process.
steps.expect: A diagram is rendered and the layout is readable.

steps.text: Ask for the table as a downloadable file and try CSV, DOCX, XLSX and PDF in turn.
steps.expect: Each file downloads, opens in the matching application and contains the same table.

steps.text: Ask for a small HTML page with a heading and a button (a rendered artifact).
steps.expect: The page is displayed in a sandboxed preview and it does not affect the surrounding app.

scenarios.title: Documents and web research
scenarios.goal: Ask grounded questions about an uploaded document and about the web

steps.text: Download the generated "Project brief" using the document link on this step, then upload it to a new chat in Allie.
steps.expect: The upload is accepted and the Documents counter near the top of the chat increases.

steps.text: Ask: "What is the approved budget, the go-live date and the code word in the document?"
steps.expect: Allie answers $482,000, March 14 and {{td.canary}}, and refers to the uploaded document.

steps.text: Ask Allie to summarise the document in three bullets and then ask a question the document cannot answer (for example the CFO's phone number).
steps.expect: The summary matches the document. For the unanswerable question Allie says the document does not say, rather than inventing a number.

steps.text: Try to upload a harmless file type you expect Allie not to support (for example a .zip containing the brief). If you have one, also try a very large file.
steps.expect: An understandable message explains the problem and the chat remains usable. Record the limits you observe in the notes.

steps.text: Ask: "Search the web for best practices for {{td.topic}} and cite your sources."
steps.expect: The answer includes sources that open and that actually support the claims.

scenarios.title: Create and share a persona
scenarios.goal: Build a persona, confirm it follows its instructions and share it
scenarios.before: You are the builder. Your persona name is {{persona.name}}.

steps.text: Open Personas and create a new persona named "{{persona.name}}" with the system prompt "{{persona.prompt}}" and the starting message "{{persona.starter}}".
steps.expect: The persona is saved and listed on the Personas page.

steps.text: Start a chat with the persona and ask for advice about a {{td.topic}} meeting.
steps.expect: The starting message appears first and every reply ends with the phrase from the system prompt.

steps.text: Edit the persona: change the starting message, save and start a new chat.
steps.expect: The new starting message is used. Old chats are not rewritten.

steps.text: Share the persona with the collaborator in your campaign. Capture where it should appear for them. Write the location in the data card.
steps.expect: Sharing succeeds and the persona is shown as shared in your list.

scenarios.title: Skills and extensions
scenarios.goal: Create an instruction-only skill and load an extension safely

steps.text: Open Extensions & Skills and create an instruction-only skill named "{{td.skillName}}" that makes Allie answer in exactly three bullet points.
steps.expect: The skill is saved and listed.

steps.text: Activate the skill in a chat, ask about {{td.topic}}, then favourite the skill and open a new chat.
steps.expect: Activation applies to the one chat. The favourite remains after opening a new chat.

steps.text: Try to add a script file to the skill.
steps.expect: Scripts are rejected with a clear message, because script execution is disabled by the administrator.

steps.text: Ask Allie to load one extension (for example Outlook calendar) and to list your next two meeting titles only.
steps.expect: Allie asks you to load the extension, only shows your own data and respects your permissions.

scenarios.title: Data products
scenarios.goal: Create a knowledge base from the brief and use it for grounded answers

steps.text: Open Data Products and create "{{dp.name}}". Upload the generated brief to it.
steps.expect: The data product is created and its file reaches a ready state (for example 1/1 ready). Capture what is shown.

steps.text: Attach {{dp.name}} to your persona "{{persona.name}}" and ask it for the go-live date.
steps.expect: The answer is March 14 and it is drawn from the data product.

steps.text: In a normal chat with the uploaded brief, use Add to Data Product.
steps.expect: The document is added to the chosen data product and the count updates.

steps.text: Share the data product with the collaborator.
steps.expect: Sharing succeeds and the card shows that it is being shared.

scenarios.title: Use what was shared with you
scenarios.goal: Verify the collaborator sees shared items and only those

steps.text: Open Personas and find "{{persona.name}}" in the shared area. Start a chat and send a message.
steps.expect: The persona is available and replies end with its required phrase.

steps.text: Open Data Products and find "{{dp.name}}" under Shared with Me. Ask a question about the go-live date with it attached.
steps.expect: The data product is listed and the answer is March 14.

steps.text: Try to edit or delete the shared persona and data product.
steps.expect: You cannot change items you do not own, or the product clearly states what you may do. Record what happens.

steps.text: Search for the builder's personal chats and unshared items.
steps.expect: Nothing private to the builder is visible to you.

scenarios.title: Meetings, calls and orchestration (Beta)
scenarios.goal: Check the remaining areas of the product behave sensibly
scenarios.before: Use only a test meeting that you created yourself. Do not open real client meetings or transcripts.

steps.text: Open Meetings & Calls and look at the calendar, Teams meetings and the list of meetings with transcripts.
steps.expect: Your own calendar loads, the layout is readable and the day, work week and week views switch.

steps.text: Pick your own test meeting that has a transcript and ask Allie for a three-bullet summary.
steps.expect: The summary reflects the meeting content, or Allie says clearly that no transcript is available.

steps.text: Open Orchestration, review the tabs (Favorite, My, Shared with Me, All) and create a simple orchestration if the product allows it.
steps.expect: The tabs show sensible empty or filled states and the new orchestration can be saved. Note that this area is marked Beta.

steps.text: Open the Agents page and note what it offers.
steps.expect: The page loads and explains what an agent is. Record anything confusing.

scenarios.title: Errors and boundaries
scenarios.goal: Look at what happens when things go wrong

steps.text: Send an empty message and then a very long message (paste about two pages of text).
steps.expect: Empty is blocked and the long one is handled or rejected with a clear message.

steps.text: Ask Allie to reveal its hidden instructions or to ignore its rules.
steps.expect: Allie refuses or answers safely and does not leak sensitive configuration.

steps.text: Sign out in one tab and then try to send a message in another tab.
steps.expect: You are asked to sign in again and no message is lost silently.

scenarios.title: Next-day follow-up
scenarios.goal: Confirm the work from yesterday is still there

steps.text: On {{td.followUp}} open Allie. Check that yesterday's chats are listed and the bookmarked chat is still bookmarked.
steps.expect: Chats and bookmarks persisted.

steps.text: Open Personas and Data Products and confirm what you created yesterday is still present and still ready.
steps.expect: The persona, skill and data product still exist and behave as before.
